tldr: Jupiter through the 6th house expands work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 6th house, it makes more room around work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
